The jurisdiction's statute is a pure notice act, since it voids unrecorded conveyances only against persons "having actual notice" of the prior deed. The farmer had actual notice of the rancher-to-son deed, so he took subject to it. The buyer paid value, had no actual notice, and recorded, so he takes free of the son's unrecorded deed. Second counts inversions. On Sample 1 that gives 1 row inversion plus 2 column inversions, which is 3, matching the expected output. It also outputs -1 on Sample 2 and 0 on Sample 3.
